import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/contracts/%7Bcontract_id%7D/invoice_configuration")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

patch.description: Update a specific Contract's Invoice Configuration

separate_billing_for_stored_materials.description: Whether billing for materials separately from the work complete is allowed. Cannot be enabled when contract_invoicing_method is simplified; attempting to set it to true in that case returns a 422 error.

contract_invoicing_method.description: The invoicing method for the contract. Only accepted for commitments when simplified invoicing is enabled for the project or company; otherwise the value is ignored. Locked once any invoice exists on the commitment; attempting to change it after invoices exist returns a 422 error. Changing to simplified disables incompatible settings (separate_billing_for_stored_materials is set to false).

Returned when the requested change is invalid, for example when attempting to change contract_invoicing_method after invoices already exist on the commitment, or when enabling separate_billing_for_stored_materials while contract_invoicing_method is simplified.

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"invoice_configuration\":{\"separate_billing_for_stored_materials\":true,\"stored_materials_billing_method\":\"move_new_materials\",\"contract_invoicing_method\":\"progressive\"}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("PATCH", "/rest/v1.0/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/contracts/%7Bcontract_id%7D/invoice_configuration", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
